input.question: What was popular British opinion of the American Revolution?
input.ground_truth: Something that could be used to gauge popular opinion in that time was voting in the House of Commons. The last time any PM was defeated over issue of war and peace (until David Cameron on Syria) was in 1782 regarding the rebellious American colonies.
